construction.name: exact_common_axis_affine_prism_transfer
construction.proof:
COMPLETE NATIVE COMMON-AXIS AFFINE PRISM HEIGHT TRANSFER

Prior mechanism. The archived prism_returns/published_pentagon.py already
applies diag(1,1,L) to the complete canonical pentagonal lattice and its
owners. This extension applies the same invertible whole-packing map to
arbitrary complete native sources whose ACTUAL rational quaternion matrices
have exactly parallel axes. It is not a claim that affine height change is new.

Fix a regular k-gon base of edge one and source and target prism heights h,H
in {1,3/2,2,3}. Let P_h=B_k x [-h/2,h/2]. A native source has complete owners
c_i+R_i P_h, with R_i the exact normalized rational quaternion matrix.
Choose d=R_0 e_3, and require exactly R_i e_3 in {d,-d} for every i.
Equivalently its cross product with d vanishes exactly; no tolerance is used.
Let r=H/h>0 and A=I+(r-1)dd^T/(d.d). Then
  A R_i = R_i diag(1,1,r),
so A(c_i+R_i P_h)=A c_i+R_i P_H. A is invertible (eigenvalues 1,1,r),
therefore preserves disjoint interiors of every pair simultaneously. This
is one map shared by all owners, not independent shortening or changing
separators. It allows expansion and contraction. All actual frames remain.

Normalize using the project's complete exact canonical vertex sets, not
only a height label: check {diag(1,1,r)v : v in P_h}=vertices(P_H) in the
same exact field, with all base coordinates unchanged. This is required
for every ordered supported source/target height pair used.

For the finite cube host, compute every actual transformed vertex in its
exact number field. Bound its coordinate extrema by outward rational
intervals l_j,u_j. Set m=(l+u)/2 and S=max_j(u_j-l_j), and use centers
A c_i-m. Each full owner lies in [-S/2,S/2]^3. No old host shape is assumed
to transform into a cube; all actual transformed owner walls are charged.

The inverse decoder retains source native SHA/path/Git provenance and
original authors, owner index, source and target heights, rational d,A,m,
and the original quaternion. Recover c_i=A^{-1}(c'_i+m). The complete
source and every transformed owner are retained. A later literal prefix
must keep the full parent map and cost before deleting named owners.

Native restoration. Multiply all recentered target centers by one common
rho>1 and enlarge the common cube to rho*S plus a stated outward margin;
keep frames fixed. Since each target prism contains zero in its interior,
every separating source plane acquires strict positive separation and
wall margin under this operation. In exact arithmetic a transformed
source separator n becomes A^{-T}n; verify all target pairs and host walls
again after binary64 center rounding. The quaternions are copied exactly
from the native source. The metric screen proposes candidates only;
complete source/native and canonical-equality checks precede promotion.

construction.name: alternating_whole_triangle_strip_return
construction.proof:
ALTERNATING WHOLE-TRIANGLE STRIP RETURN

The ordinary bounding cell loses half its area for an equilateral triangle.
Recover that area by a physical marked return before attempting a metric
realization. Put a=1/sqrt(3). The canonical unit-edge triangle has vertices
(a,0),(-a/2,1/2),(-a/2,-1/2). For index t>=0, use its identity frame when
t is even and its half-turn about z when t is odd. Put its center at
((t mod 2)*a/2,t/2,0). Consecutive triangles share a complete oblique edge;
their interiors lie on opposite sides of that edge. Nonconsecutive
triangles have disjoint y interiors except possible shared boundary.
Extruding each complete triangle through the same prism height L keeps
the same nonoverlap and all whole-owner identities.

A strip of m such prisms lies in the exact rectangle
[-a/2,a] by [-1/2,m/2], extruded through [-L/2,L/2]. Its dimensions are
sqrt(3)/2, (m+1)/2, L. Its midpoint is (a/4,(m-1)/4,0).
The additional half-unit of height is the retained pair of end costs;
it may not be discarded by an infinite-strip density argument.

Put complete strips in disjoint rectangular grid cells using these exact
dimensions. A grid A by B by C fits in the common cube of side
max(A*sqrt(3)/2,B*(m+1)/2,C*L), and contains A*B*C*m complete prisms.
Keep an explicitly indexed subset of N whole owners. This is a complete
finite return, not a marginal planar capacity statement.

The source is the classical equilateral triangular tiling and Cartesian
composition. PingYou Ltd supplies the finite strip/grid assemblies and
their certificates, without claiming the classical tiling as new. The
zero-gain ordinary-length branch and every tested finite strip length
remain useful controls. Native witnesses round the prescribed centers,
apply one common tiny outward dilation, retain the exact two half-turn
quaternions, and are checked on every actual host wall and owner pair.
construction.native_decoder: Within each grid cell use strip owner t at ((t mod2)*sqrt(3)/6,t/2,0), subtract exact_strip_midpoint, and add the centered rectangular grid-cell midpoint. Retain only the listed complete-owner words; multiply every resulting center by1.0000001, retain quaternion[t mod2], and use host nominal_scale*1.0000001+1e-7 rounded upward.
